scenes.title: One messy idea
scenes.accessibleDescription: A performer wants every inquiry in one reliable place.

scenes.title: Cloud → contract → code
scenes.accessibleDescription: Turn a raw idea into a shared agreement and a system you can evaluate.

scenes.title: Two loops
scenes.accessibleDescription: Conversations create alignment. Delivery turns an agreement into evidence.

scenes.title: Start with a brain dump
scenes.accessibleDescription: Put the context and uncertainty on the table, in your own words.

scenes.title: Mirror the idea
scenes.accessibleDescription: Ask the agent to describe the goal, people, actions, and expected result.

scenes.title: The alignment gate
scenes.accessibleDescription: The owner confirms the experience before the architecture rests on it.

scenes.title: Research reality
scenes.accessibleDescription: Distinguish what exists, what is planned, and what is still unknown.

scenes.title: Make decisions visible
scenes.accessibleDescription: Compare choices that change the design, then preserve why a choice was made.

scenes.title: Architecture → specification
scenes.accessibleDescription: Describe how the pieces fit, then define the behavior that can be tested.

scenes.title: Authorize the build
scenes.accessibleDescription: A kickoff tells a fresh agent what to do, what is allowed, and how to verify.

scenes.title: Build in small slices
scenes.accessibleDescription: Deliver one complete, verifiable behavior at a time and document the result.

scenes.title: Evidence has levels
scenes.accessibleDescription: Match the claim to the observation that actually supports it.

scenes.title: Your turn
scenes.accessibleDescription: Carry one small idea through the stages and make the next action clear.
